title: Futaba Corporation to Acquire Surface Drone Maker Homare Heavy Industries as a Subsidiary
[Futaba Corporation] (6986) Expects approximately 2.3 billion yen in extraordinary profit from land sale in Chiba, acquires water drone company Homare Heavy Industries as a ...
Futaba Corporation agreed to acquire 91.90% stake in Homura Heavy Industries Corporation from Kiji Co., Ltd. and others for approximately ¥700 million.
